title: Reltio Apps Catalog
description: Catalog of Reltio platform applications with metadata for navigation, integration, and automation.

$schema.description: Reference to the JSON Schema for validation.

uri.description: Absolute URL to the application. Can use `${environment}` and `${tenant}` placeholders for dynamic URLs.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the application.

description.description: Brief description of the application's purpose and capabilities.

icon.description: Absolute URL to the application icon (SVG).

category.description: Application category for grouping in navigation.
